name: PharmaResources (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.
summary: PharmaResources (Shanghai) Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a one-stop integrated service provider for new drug research, development, and commercial manufacturing to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies in China and internationally. The company offers contract research organization (CRO), contract manufacturing organization (CMO), contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO), and commercial manufacturing services for small molecule drugs. It is also involved in the research, development, and customized/commercial production of active pharmaceutical ingredients and key intermediates, including ticagrelor, oxiracetam, l-carnitine, velpatasvir, peramiv…
